hero.title: Glaciers, lakes and mountains.
hero.subtitle: We're your base camp in El Calafate. We help you arrange transfers to the main attractions and plan every outing.

intro.title: The outings you can't miss.
intro.description: Daily departures in season from the town centre. Our front-desk team helps you plan and book every excursion.

help.title: Want help building your itinerary?
help.description: Check excursion availability and prices directly at the hotel front desk or via WhatsApp. Book your room and we'll help you with the rest.

peritoMoreno.name: Perito Moreno Glacier
peritoMoreno.description: Patagonia's most famous glacier. A full-day bus excursion with wooden walkways and privileged views of the glacier in motion.

minitrekking.name: Glacier Minitrekking
minitrekking.description: A walk on the Perito Moreno ice with crampons and certified guides. A unique experience combining a boat crossing and trekking.

navigation.name: Lake Argentino Cruise
navigation.description: A lake safari across Lake Argentino with views of the Upsala, Spegazzini and Onelli glaciers. Departs from Puerto Bandera.

chalten.name: El Chaltén – Fitz Roy
chalten.description: Argentina's national trekking capital. Trails with views of Mount Fitz Roy and Cerro Torre in Los Glaciares National Park.
